method: Viewed all 16 contact sheets at 2fps across four full timelines, plus all four full-size seated screenshots. Discrete engineering review; not continuous human acceptance.
findings: Both layouts use original room meshes; room-b shifts and rotates the actual chair by -90 degrees.
Sampled approach, seated pose, rising and walking away remain visible in the original room camera.
No conspicuous new body displacement, broken mesh or teleport observed in inspected samples.
Numerical pelvis height retains the original same-body seated calibration. This is not full body-surface clearance measurement.
